mentions.name: 3D printed Ray-Bans glasses case insert
mentions.description: A 3D printed replacement insert for a Ray-Bans glasses case. The creator uses Claude to reverse engineer the case geometry and shares prompt techniques for working with 3D models (presenting all orientations for human selection, and reducing 3D problems to 2D streamline drawings).
mentions.problem: The original glasses case insert is likely to break, so a more durable replacement is needed.
mentions.source_excerpt: ive been getting claude to reverse engineer my raybans glasses case, so i can figure out a 3d printed insert to put in thats less likely to break.
